title: The Episode About the First Sikh Guni

blocks.text: The child’s greatness became known to many, and the news reached even the ministers in Delhi. (24)
When Baba Ji grew older, he was sent to a teacher so that he might be instructed according to custom. (25)
Many marvels were seen in his learning, and the account of them spread everywhere. (26)
When he came of age and entered household life, he still remained inwardly detached. (27)
He worked in the storehouse, yet did not cling to profit; with Mardana beside him, he sang the Shabad on the rabab. (28)
